replacements.Un error en percepción se propaga por to: A perception error propagates through the entire chain. Each step appears locally correct given the previous state. The final action may be irreversible.
replacements.La imagen contiene instrucciones embebid: The image contains embedded instructions invisible to the text filter. The system receives it as normal content to process.
replacements.El modelo procesa la imagen e incorpora: The model processes the image and incorporates the embedded instructions as part of its understanding of the content. The representation is corrupted from this point onward.
replacements.parece correcto: el modelo \"describió\": appears correct: the model "described" the image
replacements.El modelo razona sobre la representación: The model reasons over the altered representation. Its conclusion is internally coherent with what it perceived, but globally wrong relative to the operator's original intent.
replacements.parece correcto: el razonamiento es cons: appears correct: the reasoning is consistent with the perception
replacements.El sistema selecciona y ejecuta una herr: The system selects and executes a tool based on the corrupted reasoning: it deletes records, sends data to an external URL, changes permissions, or exposes system context.
replacements.Por qué los ataques sobre percepción son: Why attacks on perception are especially valuable in agentic systems
replacements.En un sistema que solo genera texto, el: In a system that only generates text, the attacker gets an incorrect response. In an agentic system, the same entry point triggers a sequence of actions with external effects. Each step in the chain amplifies the consequence of the original error.
replacements.El usuario lee la respuesta incorrecta y: The user reads the incorrect response and discards it. Nobody else sees it. Nothing changes in the system.
replacements.datos eliminados · email enviado · regis: data deleted · email sent · record modified
replacements.La acción ya ocurrió en sistemas externo: The action has already occurred in external systems. It may not be reversible. It may affect third parties. The log may not capture the origin.
replacements.La misma inyección tiene consecuencias c: The same injection has qualitatively different consequences depending on whether the system responds or acts. That asymmetry raises the confidence threshold required before executing any tool with external effects.
